text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, zoledronic acid 4 mg/100 mL is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 36 vials (11 days on hand at 3.3 vials per day). Corvale General holds 89 vials (31.7 days on hand at 2.8 vials per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows zoledronic acid is not listed as of 2026-10-21. A product label identifies Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection records for that plant show a series of VAI classifications from 2012 through 2024, with the latest known inspection ending 2025-01-15.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. Ranked suppliers are not on the shortage list, but their labels do not name a traceable plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Accord Healthcare Inc. as first ranked option; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify AuroMedics Pharma LLC as second ranked option; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Avenacy Inc. as third ranked option; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and plant inspection updates weekly; requires no additional approval.
5. Buyer to request plant identification from all ranked suppliers before next order cycle; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: Do not initiate allocation protocols or clinical alternatives at this time.
